body.statement: For every fixed \(\alpha\in(0,1)\), with \(\mathcal M_n^{\mathrm{CY}}\) the \(n\)-th slice of the complete-array class \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY}}\), \[\sup_{P_n\in\mathcal M_n^{\mathrm{CY}}}\sup_{z\in\mathbb R}\left|P_n\left(\max_{k\in\mathcal K_n}\frac{|\widehat\tau_k-\tau_k^{\mathrm{event}}|}{\widehat s_k}\le z\right)-P_n\left(\max_{k\in\mathcal K_n}|Z_{n,k}|\le z\right)\right|\to0,\quad Z_n\sim N(0,\Sigma_n),\] and the conditional law of \(W_n^\xi\) has the same limit uniformly over this slice. Therefore \[\inf_{P_n\in\mathcal M_n^{\mathrm{CY}}}P_n\{\tau_k^{\mathrm{event}}\in\mathcal C_{n,k}\text{ for every }k\in\mathcal K_n\}\to1-\alpha.\] The complete class includes arrays with \(K_n\to\infty\) and nonzero staircase off-diagonals, so this strictly goes beyond scalar Choi--Yuan inference.
body.justification: This is the headline whole-path coverage result for an identified event curve under structured MNAR completion.
body.gap: Choi--Yuan establish scalar or blockwise normality; Yan--Wainwright give entrywise intervals; Xia--Yan--Wainwright give heteroskedastic pointwise and nonasymptotic confidence intervals for general scalar weighted bilinear treatment-effect functionals; and Callaway--Sant'Anna give simultaneous paths under parallel trends. None supplies the joint growing-\(K_n\) law, shared-cell covariance estimation, and simultaneous Choi--Yuan multiplier band.
body.consumer: The right-to-carry analysis can replace pointwise visual uncertainty with one honest band over all reported exposure durations.

obligation.what_is_open: The uniform feasible transfer from the oracle influence maximum to the studentized conditional multiplier band.
obligation.obstruction: This transfer requires the unresolved uniform nonlinear-remainder rate and feasible covariance rate. It also requires theorem-granularity logical nodes for high-dimensional Gaussian approximation, Gaussian anti-concentration, and Gaussian covariance comparison. The bibliography record alone is not a proof premise. The frozen cell-leverage and sub-Gaussian conditions identify the inputs to such results, but they do not themselves state their conclusions.
obligation.attempted: Reduced the multiplier law exactly, conditional on the data, to the maximum of an \(N(0,\widehat\Sigma_n)\) vector; derived the explicit perturbation from estimated studentization and the nonlinear remainder; and verified that the claimed upstream logarithmic rates are sufficient for anti-concentration. The argument cannot be completed while those upstream rates and classical theorem nodes are absent.
obligation.partial_result:
Define the oracle linear process and feasible multiplier coordinates by
\[
S_{n,k}=\sum_{q\in\mathcal Q_n^{\mathrm{IF}}}
 a_{kq}\frac{e_q}{\sigma_q},
\qquad
\widehat Z_{n,k}^{\xi}
=\sum_{q=(u,v)\in\mathcal Q_n^{\mathrm{IF}}}
 \frac{\widehat c_{kq}\widehat\sigma_u}{\widehat s_k}\xi_q.
\]
Conditional on \(Y\), the multiplier vector is exactly Gaussian and
\[
\operatorname{Cov}\!\left(
 \widehat Z_{n,k}^{\xi},\widehat Z_{n,k'}^{\xi}\mid Y\right)
=\frac{\sum_q\widehat c_{kq}\widehat c_{k'q}
 \widehat\sigma_u^2}{\widehat s_k\widehat s_{k'}}
=\widehat\Sigma_{kk'}.
\]
Hence no separate multiplier central limit theorem is needed after
consistent estimation of the full covariance: conditionally,
\(W_n^\xi\) is exactly the maximum absolute coordinate of a
\(N(0,\widehat\Sigma_n)\) vector.

For the feasible statistic, put \(t_k=\widehat s_k/s_k\).  The exact
influence identity gives
\[
\max_{k\in\mathcal K_n}
 \frac{|\widehat\tau_k-\tau_k^{\mathrm{event}}|}{\widehat s_k}
=\max_{k\in\mathcal K_n}|t_k^{-1}(S_{n,k}+\rho_{n,k})|.
\]
On the event \(\max_k|t_k-1|\le\gamma_n<1\), the reverse triangle
inequality implies
\[
\left|
 \max_k|t_k^{-1}(S_{n,k}+\rho_{n,k})|-
 \max_k|S_{n,k}|
\right|
\le
\frac{\gamma_n}{1-\gamma_n}\max_k|S_{n,k}|
+\frac{\|\rho_n\|_\infty}{1-\gamma_n}.
\]
Independence, centeredness, the sub-Gaussian bound, and
\(\sum_q a_{kq}^2=1\) give
\(\max_k|S_{n,k}|=O_{P_n}(\sqrt{\log(2K)})\) by the exponential Markov
inequality and a union bound.  Therefore the asserted scale rate
\(\gamma_n=o_{P_n}((\log(2K))^{-1})\) makes the first term
\(o_{P_n}((\log(2K))^{-1/2})\).  The asserted influence rate together
with
\(\Delta_{\mathrm{CY},n}(K)\sqrt{\log(2K)}\to0\) makes the second term
of the same smaller order after choosing a slowly diverging tightness
constant.  A theorem-granularity Gaussian approximation and Gaussian
anti-concentration result would then transfer the oracle process to
\(N(0,\Sigma_n)\), while a Gaussian covariance-comparison result and
\(\|\widehat\Sigma_n-\Sigma_n\|_{\max}
=o_{P_n}((\log(2K))^{-2})\) would transfer its law to the exact
conditional multiplier law above.  These last classical results are
not declared logical nodes, and the two required upstream stochastic
rates remain unproved in the frozen core.
